title: The Forge Spirit
text: A shape of glowing slag stirs in the ruined furnace, molten and slow, with two white-hot eyes. It speaks in the hiss of quenched steel. It offers to temper one weapon in its own heart, but it is hungry, and it wants something to burn.

options.label: Feed it a piece of good iron, and trust it to give back better.

outcomes.text: It eats the iron with a hiss, then hands back a better blade.

options.label: The strongest feeds it their own heat, willing to pay in flesh.

outcomes.text: It drinks the warmth from their arm, leaving it grey and cold, and grants a gift in return. The arm never feels quite warm again.

options.label: Quench it with water. Hungry things are better put out.

outcomes.text: It does not like that at all, and it is still very hot.
